bullets.text: Accenture Acquires COMWARE — Accenture is acquiring COMWARE to enhance its capabilities in supporting mid-market companies in Japan, particularly in AI and digital transformation.

McCoy Acquisition Boosts SAP Expertise — Accenture's acquisition of McCoy will strengthen its SAP (Systems, Applications, and Products) capabilities and AI innovation for mid-market clients in Europe.
Expansion of Accenture Edge — Both acquisitions will enhance Accenture Edge, which focuses on helping mid-market companies modernize operations and adopt AI technologies effectively.
Increased Workforce — The acquisition of COMWARE adds over 180 professionals, while McCoy brings more than 380 specialists, expanding Accenture's talent pool for mid-market services.
Focus on Mid-Market Growth — These strategic acquisitions aim to accelerate growth for mid-market companies by providing tailored solutions that integrate AI and modern business practices.
